description:
A single customer-requested Contact Flow behavior, mapped to the
Amazon Connect blocks that implement it (with dependency ordering).

This is the unit the Contact Flow generator MUST realize in the flow JSON.

description.description: What the customer asked for, in their words
description.title: Description

blocks.description: Ordered Amazon Connect block Types that implement this behavior (e.g. ['UpdateContactCallbackNumber','TransferContactToQueue']). Order encodes dependency: each block's NextAction points to the next.
blocks.title: Blocks

depends_on.description: Other behaviors/blocks that must precede this one (e.g. 'dtmf_auth' before 'agent_escalation')
depends_on.title: Depends On

title: FlowBehavior
